summary_md: **小微 ([@robinliu2022](https://x.com/robinliu2022/status/2116327896050712730))** summarizes *Broken on Arrival* ([paper page](https://huggingface.co/papers/2609.05881)). Of 305 coding-capable GGUF tags across 15 Ollama model lines, 7 (2.3%) solve at most 6 of 164 HumanEval+ problems, and all of them are low-bit quantizations under 4B.
